name: Jetstub
summary: A travel wallet whose passes lift out, flip in 3D under your finger and get stamped at the gate
about: A phone wallet holding a flight, an intercity coach ticket and an Eid night bazaar pass. Each pass lifts out of the stack on a spring while the others sink, then turns in real 3D as you swipe, with a gloss that slides across and a shadow that thins edge-on. Show it at the gate and the screen brightens, a scanner beam reads the drawn QR code, a stamp thumps down and the pass slides back marked as used.
how: Tap a pass or drag it up to lift it out of the wallet; the other passes sink and dim behind it.
Swipe the open pass sideways to flip it: it follows your finger, a quick flick counts, and it springs to the front or the back.
The back holds your QR code, booking reference and seat; the front keeps a live countdown to boarding.
Press Show at gate to brighten the screen, scan the code and stamp it; the pass returns to the stack marked as used.
Keyboard: Tab or the arrow keys move between passes, Enter opens, Space or F flips and Escape puts the pass back.
